build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Drive or fly a responsive 3D racer across at least three planetary regions with drifting, boost, braking, jumps, and checkpoint validation. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Choose branching routes on a navigable system map, trading distance against storms, gravity wells, tolls, and repair opportunities. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Manage fuel, battery, hull, and engine heat; overboosting must create visible performance loss and possible breakdown. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Race distinct rivals with recognizable vehicles and tactics, including drafting, blocking, shortcuts, and opportunistic rescues. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Collect sponsors, upgrades, and route intelligence through optional events that create meaningful mechanical tradeoffs. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Complete a multi-leg championship with standings, stage results, rival consequences, and at least two final outcomes. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Between legs, players install mutually exclusive modules that alter handling, efficiency, durability, scanning, or boost behavior. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger states in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

Every important player action has immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state change. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled title and start flow, playable core systems, progression or escalation, final success/failure state, and retry or return navigation all work without reloading the page. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: Bright retro-futurist motorsport with saturated planetary skies, holographic gates, heat trails, modular vehicles, and readable cosmic route graphics. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

The 3D environment has deliberate composition, lighting, material contrast, depth cues, and themed landmarks rather than an empty floor with scattered objects. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Primary interactive actors, machines, targets, hazards, and UI symbols have readable silhouettes and visibly different functional states. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

Movement, impacts, transitions, alerts, completion moments, and interface changes use smooth multi-frame animation, particles, camera treatment, or audio-reactive motion. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
